title: Draw the Mark III so it reads as the third robot at a glance
tier_reason: A generated sprite landing in assets/, with provenance; git reverts it.
ask: A third bot sheet on bot.png's exact layout (192x192, 4x4 of 48px, rows down/up/left/right, frame 0 the standing idle) so entities/bot.gd draws it with no new code. It must be tellable from the Mk I and Mk II at the table's viewing distance, and per the Q-84 ruling it should read as a machine.
first_action: Generate through the Retro Diffusion pipeline with the palette lock and post-processing, archive the raws under assets/raw/ as a dated batch, record provenance in CREDITS.md, and add the sheet path to the bot_mk3 row's icon.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-09, chief of staff session: v0.2.1 is the Mark III, the robot that learns by reinforcement (P-14).
result: Done and on main. assets/sprites/generated/bot_mk3.png: the Mark I's chassis in a teal-green ramp with a three-pixel antenna and a lit amber bead, planted per frame on the head so it sways through the walk; every cell keeps bot.png's edges and feet baseline to the pixel, the only outline change is the antenna. Three Retro Diffusion calls, four images at 96x96, seed 30903, $0.119 (API balance $0.745 to $0.626); raws, meta, prompts and the compositing script archived at assets/raw/2026-09-09-bot-mk3/; provenance paragraph in CREDITS.md. Wired: the bot_mk3 catalogue row's icon and entities/bot.gd's sheet choice. Both suites green after wiring. Not yet recorded in hq/data/spend.json, which another session holds open. Chief of staff looked at the sheet: tellable from the Mk II at a glance, reads as the same machine.

conversation.text: Why don't I see Mark III on http://127.0.0.1:8642/#/entities?

The HQ entities page and the in-game shop read two different files. The game's catalogue (`systems/machine_defs.gd`) does have `bot_mk3` pointing at the new sheet — that's wired and tested. But the page you're looking at is driven by `hq/data/entities.json`, a hand-kept file that has entries for `bot` and `bot_mk2` and nothing for `bot_mk3` — I never added the third one. That's the gap: the sheet's real and shipped, it just isn't listed where you're looking.

I'll add the `bot_mk3` entry to `hq/data/entities.json` now, same shape as the Mk II one (same 4x4/48px frame grid, same four walk animations plus the idle), with its own name and description, and confirm it renders on the page.
